hooks.name: dead-install-blocker
hooks.description: Blocks an npm, pnpm, yarn, pip, uv or poetry install of a package Graveyard can show is Dead or Cursed. Fails open.

action.command: if command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then uvx --from "graveyard-backend @ git+https://github.com/olajaido/graveyard.git@<COMMIT_SHA>#subdirectory=backend" graveyard check-install; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; exit 0
